components.css: .ds-button{font-family:var(--font-body);min-height:50px;padding:12px 24px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--color-accent);color:var(--color-on-accent);font-size:16px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:transform var(--duration) var(--ease),opacity var(--duration) var(--ease)}.ds-button:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);opacity:.9}.ds-button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-input:focus-visible,.ds-filter:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-project a:focus-visible,.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-focus);outline-offset:5px;transition:none}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-project{font-family:var(--font-body);display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.25fr) 160px;gap:44px;padding:36px 32px;background:var(--color-paper-2);color:var(--color-ink);transition:transform var(--duration) var(--ease)}.ds-project:hover{transform:translateX(4px)}.ds-project h3{margin:0;font-size:clamp(22px,2vw,28px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.04em}.ds-project p{margin:0;line-height:1.6}.ds-project .ds-category{margin-top:16px;color:var(--color-accent);font-size:15px}.ds-project a{color:inherit;font-size:14px;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-project a:hover{color:var(--color-accent)}.ds-button:focus-visible,.ds-input:focus-visible,.ds-filter:focus-visible,.ds-nav a:focus-visible,.ds-project a:focus-visible,.ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--color-focus);outline-offset:5px;transition:none}@media(max-width:1000px){.ds-project{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);gap:24px}.ds-project a{grid-column:2}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-project{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);padding:28px 24px}.ds-project a{grid-column:auto}.ds-project:hover{transform:none}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-project{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: You build on a cinematic landscape that moves between neon night and luminous dawn. Original generated sun and horizon imagery supplies the atmosphere; large, tightly spaced type gives the portfolio its identity. Plum and rose surfaces keep project evidence readable below the landscape.
keyCharacteristics: Theme-specific original landscapes with a matching surface palette.
One self-hosted type family and a monumental name.
Flat rectangular rows, restrained controls, and generous section spacing.
Native keyboard interaction and a reduced-motion alternative.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Change the landscape, page surfaces, text, field colors, and focus treatment together.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use established surface contrast for hierarchy; do not add shadows to ordinary rows or panels.

dos: Do extend active semantic CSS tokens.
Do preserve keyboard activation, visible focus, theme persistence, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do pair night and dawn imagery with matching palettes.
donts: Don't introduce unverified metrics or testimonials.
Don't describe email composition as completed delivery.
Don't copy unused legacy styles into the current system.
